sn40.10:48.1: It’s good to have experiential confidence in the teaching:
sn40.10:48.2: ‘The teaching is well explained by the Buddha—apparent in the present life, immediately effective, inviting inspection, relevant, so that sensible people can know it for themselves.’
sn40.10:48.3: It’s the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.
sn40.10:48.4: They surpass other gods in ten respects:
sn40.10:49.1: It’s good to have experiential confidence in the Saṅgha:
sn40.10:49.2: ‘The Saṅgha of the Buddha’s disciples is practicing the way that’s good, direct, systematic, and proper. It consists of the four pairs, the eight individual persons. This is the Saṅgha of the Buddha’s disciples that is worthy of offerings dedicated to the gods, worthy of hospitality, worthy of a religious donation, worthy of greeting with cupped palms, and is the supreme field of merit for the world.’
sn40.10:49.3: It’s the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.
sn40.10:49.4: They surpass other gods in ten respects:
sn40.10:50.1: It’s good to have the ethical conduct that’s loved by the noble ones, unbroken, impeccable, spotless, and unmarred, liberating, praised by sensible people, not mistaken, and leading to immersion.
sn40.10:50.2: It’s the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.
sn40.10:50.3: They surpass other gods in ten respects:
sn40.10:50.4: heavenly lifespan, beauty, happiness, glory, sovereignty, sights, sounds, smells, tastes, and touches.”
